name: Baobab ERP — Workforce Administration
description: Gate IAM-10 (ADR-0014 §6-9): workforce SSO client for iDempiere's own built-in OIDC plugin (org.idempiere.ui.sso.oidc, part of iDempiere's core distribution feature). Confidential, distinct from the bearer-only baobab-erp client. No PKCE: verified directly against org.idempiere.ui.sso.oidc's source (idempiere/idempiere) that it never sends a code_challenge, unlike baobab-trade-admin/baobab-cms-admin's browser-based flows.
